message.text: Finalize a launch review memo. Confirm Mira owns receiver/outbox, Leon owns consumers/load testing, Saanvi owns operations. Preserve alerts at 120 seconds and pause noncritical producers at 300 seconds. Gate launch on a 3600 events/s soak, duplicate delivery test, recovery drill, EU storage check, and actual cost estimate under EUR 900. Include unresolved risks, rollback triggers, and a concise decision ledger.
